footer.cta: Ready for your first class on the mat?

hero.title: Arrive, breathe,
hero.text: At {name} you practice in a calm setting, in small groups and with clear guidance – whether you are stepping onto the mat for the first time or have practiced for years.

offerings.title: Practice that fits
offerings.text: Whether on your own, in a group or for a whole weekend: the three formats can be combined freely.

quote.after: , but an invitation to arrive within yourself.

why.title: A place for true
why.text: Here it does not matter how far you can bend, but how you feel while doing it. Quiet rooms, clear guidance and plenty of time to arrive shape every class.

benefits.title: Room for
benefits.lead: Less tension, more clarity: regular practice is good for body and mind.
benefits.text: From a gentle start to a powerful series – choose what suits you today.
benefits.side: Personal guidance in every class, including for beginners

hero.title: A place with
hero.text: {name} is a place to practice and to arrive. We combine classical yoga practice with breathwork and meditation – without performance pressure and with plenty of time for each individual.

way.title: Four steps to your own
way.text: Getting started is simple: you come in, we listen, and you practice at your own pace. Here is how it works in four steps.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: You sign up for a trial class, and we briefly clarify your wishes and any complaints. You need nothing more to get started.

steps.title: Practice
steps.text: In small groups you get to know the basic poses and the breath. The teachers show variations for every body.

steps.title: Deepen
steps.text: Over time, longer sequences, meditation and breathing exercises are added – at your own pace.

steps.title: Take it with you
steps.text: You take small exercises into everyday life that you can also do at home or in the office.

sessions.title: Private session
sessions.text: Tailored entirely to you: we practice what your body and your daily life need right now.

sessions.title: Group class
sessions.text: Practice together in small groups, with fixed dates and clear guidance.

sessions.title: Retreat
sessions.text: A weekend just for you: yoga, meditation and time to arrive.

expertise.title: Solid training
expertise.text: Our teachers have completed multi-year trainings and keep learning all the time.

expertise.title: Individual adaptation
expertise.text: Every pose can be modified. We show you variations that suit your body.

expertise.title: Quiet surroundings
expertise.text: Soft light and few distractions create room to switch off.

expertise.title: Long-term support
expertise.text: We accompany you over weeks and months and adapt the practice when your daily life changes.

classes.text: All classes take place in small groups. Duration and level are shown on each class, and you can reserve a spot via the contact form.
